title: 第5章 我加钱第6章 食人画皮鬼
slug: 两界我的金手指有点无敌
content_zh:
“顾铮，以后有什么东西还可以联系我，这是我名片。”
楚姐递过来一张名片。
顾铮接过来一看，上面只有一个名字和一个电话。
原来叫楚雅。
王成在一旁眼巴巴的看着这张名片，多想顾铮撕了它。
因为这意味着从此以后两人可以直接绕开他自己交易了。
今天这一单他就进账十二万。
要以后客户都这样子，他就要喝西北风了。
然而他还没有权力阻止这种事情。
你情我愿又没和他签合同。
客户想做什么他都管不到。
还好这次赚了一笔大的。
走出酒店，顾铮昂首挺胸的，连底气都足了三分。
他现在，是千万富翁顾铮！
该换个房子了。
都千万富翁了，住在出租屋里太跌份了。
他现在租住的房间是一间三室一厅改造成的出租屋，每一间房子都是一个租客，房间很小，又不隔音，旁边的一个租客喜欢打游戏，整天打到半夜。
自从可以两界穿越之后他大部分时间都住在古代，也没来得及换房子。
现在手头的钱够了，想一次性到位买个大平层。
说实话，他毕业之后的梦想就是能在星城买一间三室一厅的房子，首付三十万，贷款一百万，还一辈子。

这还是星城，全国房价最低的一线城市。
要是在其他一线城市，首付三十万只能买个小居室，要是在魔都，首付三十万买个厕所吧。
“王哥，我想买个大平层，你这边有资源么？”
王成眼睛放光：“有！肯定有！什么价位的？”
顾铮呆了呆：“你业务范围这么广么？”
他只是随口一问，没想到还真有资源？
“哈哈哈，赚钱的我都做！要什么价位的？”
顾铮沉吟了一下：“五百万以内吧。”
“简单！三天之内给你电话！”
当天，顾铮决定不再委屈自己，直接住进了酒店，等房子到手拎包入住。
离开酒店，顾铮直奔自己的下一个目的地，直接打飞的来到龙泉宝剑的原产地龙泉市，找到一个百年老字号。
是不是百年老字号他不知道，但这家店在网上的名头口碑，名头的确不小。
磨剑堂！
门口悬挂着一个匾额，上面三个大字龙飞凤舞。
整个店铺都装修的古色生香的，摆满了各式各样的刀剑，你甚至可以看到游戏，动漫中的那些酷炫刀剑样式。
价格从几百，几千几万不等。
“你好，我想买几把刀剑。”顾铮找到店铺的一人销售，开门见山。
销售员面容姣好，面带微笑：“好的，您可以在我们店里看一看喜欢什么样式的刀剑，我可以为您一一介绍。”
顾铮摇头：“我要买可以实战的刀剑，不要样子货。”
“好的呢。”销售员笑容不变，她接待了无数个客人，大部分都是男人，无论年纪大还是小，到了这里多少有几分中二的心思，其中‘能实战’的要求不少。

“您放心，我们店里的刀剑都是用高碳钢锻造……”
顾铮直接打断他：“这些忽悠其他人的话就不用说了，算了，喊你们老板来吧。”
“先生有什么指教么？”
一个中年男子微笑着走来。
顾铮郑重道：“我想买几把刀剑，不是你们店里摆出来的这种能看不能用的，是可以对砍而不断地那种刀剑，所谓的高碳砍几下就断了。”
content_en:
"Gu Zheng, if you need anything in the future, you can contact me. This is my business card."
Sister Chu handed over a business card.
Gu Zheng took it and looked at it. There was only a name and a phone number on it.
It turned out to be Chu Ya.
Wang Cheng looked at the business card eagerly and wanted Gu Zheng to tear it up.
Because this means that from now on, the two of them can directly bypass him and trade on their own.
He earned 120,000 yuan from this single order today.
If all his customers behave like this in the future, he will drink the northwest wind.
However, he has no power to prevent this.
You love me and I didn't sign a contract with him.
He has no control over what the customer wants to do.
Fortunately, I made a big profit this time.
When he walked out of the hotel, Gu Zheng held his head high and felt confident.
He is now the multi-millionaire Gu Zheng!
It's time to change houses.
I am already a multi-millionaire, so living in a rental house is too low.
The room he is renting now is a three-bedroom and one-living room converted into a rental house. Each house has one tenant. The room is small and not soundproofed. The tenant next to him likes to play games all day long until midnight.
Since he was able to travel between the two worlds, he spent most of his time living in ancient times and didn't have time to change his house.
Now that I have enough money on hand, I want to buy a large flat floor at once.
To be honest, his dream after graduation is to buy a three-bedroom house in Star City with a down payment of 300,000 yuan and a loan of 1 million yuan, which he will pay back for a lifetime.
This is Star City, the first-tier city with the lowest housing prices in the country.
If you are in other first-tier cities, you can only buy a small apartment with a down payment of 300,000. If you are in Shanghai, you can buy a toilet with a down payment of 300,000.
"Brother Wang, I want to buy a large flat floor. Do you have the resources here?"
Wang Cheng's eyes lit up: "Yes! There must be! What's the price?"
Gu Zheng was stunned: "Is your business scope so wide?"
He just asked casually, but he didn't expect there were resources?
"Hahaha, I will do whatever makes money! What price do you want?"
Gu Zheng pondered for a moment: "Probably within five million."
"Easy! I'll call you within three days!"
On the same day, Gu Zheng decided not to wrong himself anymore and checked into the hotel directly, waiting for the house to be picked up and moved in.
After leaving the hotel, Gu Zheng went straight to his next destination. He rushed directly to Longquan City, the origin of Longquan Sword, and found a century-old brand.
He didn't know if it was a century-old brand, but the store's reputation online was indeed quite good.
Sword sharpening hall!
There is a plaque hanging at the door with three big characters on it: dragons and phoenixes.
The entire store is decorated in an antique style and is filled with all kinds of swords. You can even see the cool sword styles from games and anime.
Prices range from a few hundred to tens of thousands.
"Hello, I want to buy some swords." Gu Zheng found a salesperson in the store and got straight to the point.
The salesperson had a nice face and a smile: "Okay, you can take a look at our store to see what style of sword you like, and I can introduce them to you one by one."
Gu Zheng shook his head: "I want to buy a sword that can be used in actual combat, not a fake one."
"Okay." The salesperson's smile remained unchanged. She received countless customers, most of whom were men. Regardless of their age, they were somewhat of a middle schooler when they arrived here, and there were many requirements for "being able to practice".
"Don't worry, the swords in our shop are all forged from high-carbon steel..."
Gu Zheng interrupted him directly: "No need to say these things to fool other people. Forget it, call your boss."
"Sir, do you have any advice?"
A middle-aged man walked over with a smile.
Gu Zheng said solemnly: "I want to buy some swords. They are not the ones displayed in your store that can be seen but not used. They are the kind of swords that can be used to cut crosswise and continuously. The so-called high-carbon swords will break after a few cuts."
